name: AL Language XApp N
brief: Cross-app fixture N: a subscriber app that depends on no app and that only cross-app fixture T depends on.
description: Holds one subscriber of the Company table event of the two-top subscriber order probe (tests/al-language/events/subscriber-order/TtSubscriberOrderTests.al). Depends on no app; only cross-app fixture T depends on it. The app id is lower than the id of every other corpus app on purpose. The app id, name and publisher are fixed on purpose: they decide the candidate orders of the probe (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Multi-app fixtures"). Do not change them.
